$comment: models: each Workers AI model void-fbtee translates with, with its own settings: jsonMode (the model is on Workers AI's JSON Mode page) and options, sent with every request (its thinking turned off or to its lowest: a translation needs none, and thinking made four of the six too slow for the translator test, 2026-11-15); they're the candidates the translator test picks a language's model from. languages: the model that translates into each language, one entry per language (BCP 47 language subtag), read by models.ts for vp dev, the app's own translate() and the translator test alike. source: cloudflare (Cloudflare's own docs name the language for the model), llmgateway (https://llmgateway.io/models/translation, a third party's recommendation, until the translator test measures it), measured (the translator test, test/translator/scores.json); why says what. Checked 2026-11-15: every model is in Cloudflare's catalog and not on its November 2026 deprecation list (changelog 2026-11-05). Not used: IndicTrans2 (from English only, takes no description or examples), m2m100 (sentences alone; chrF 29.6 against Llama 3.3's 53.0 on the example's events, 2026-11-13). Any language not listed: default.

@cf/meta/llama-3.3-70b-instruct-fp8-fast.why: no thinking mode; JSON Mode works (model page)

@cf/google/gemma-4-26b-a4b-it.why: thinking on by default; off as Cloudflare's Workers AI get-started does it (checked 2026-11-15)

@cf/qwen/qwen3.8-27b.why: reasoning xhigh by default; low is its lowest (model page, reasoning_effort: low, medium, xhigh, checked 2026-11-15), and still 195 tokens and 27 s a string (AI Gateway's logs, 2026-11-15); enable_thinking false too, Qwen's own chat template switch, to be proven by the logs

@cf/openai/gpt-oss-120b.why: reasoning medium by default; low is its lowest (model page: low, medium, high, checked 2026-11-15)

@cf/deepseek-ai/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017.why: newer (2026-10-19); reasoning off with reasoning_effort none (Cloudflare's changelog, checked 2026-11-15); paid models only, 20 requests a minute; requires the Workers Paid plan, so 20 requests a minute on standard billing, per model (Workers AI "Limits", paid models, checked 2026-11-15)

@cf/thinkingmachines/inkling-2-small.why: newer (2026-11-12); reasoning off with reasoning_effort none (Cloudflare's changelog, checked 2026-11-15); requires the Workers Paid plan, so 20 requests a minute on standard billing, per model (Workers AI "Limits", paid models, checked 2026-11-15)

default.why: Gemma 4: multilingual, 35+ languages out of the box (Cloudflare's changelog, 2026-04-04), the fastest here (1 s a string, AI Gateway's logs, 2026-11-15); GLM 4.7 Flash was the default until its thinking couldn't be switched off (8192 tokens, no answer, 2026-11-15)
